items.exampleEn: The lost dog came home after two days.
items.exampleZh: 走失的狗兩天後自己回家了。

items.exampleEn: We sat at a small square table by the window.
items.exampleZh: 我們坐在窗邊一張小方桌旁。

items.exampleEn: Few people live in this remote area.
items.exampleZh: 很少人住在這個偏遠地區。

items.exampleEn: This game is for advanced players.
items.exampleZh: 這個遊戲是給高階玩家玩的。

items.exampleEn: Many unknown animals live deep in the sea.
items.exampleZh: 海洋深處住著許多還不為人知的動物。

items.exampleEn: One of my teeth is loose.
My net pay is lower than I thought.
items.exampleZh: 我的實領薪水比我想的少。

items.exampleEn: The old wooden door is split at the bottom.
items.exampleZh: 那扇舊木門的底部裂開了。

items.sentenceEn: Excuse me, I'm lost. Where is the station?
items.sentenceZh: 不好意思，我迷路了。車站在哪裡？

items.audioEn: My grandparents live in a remote village in the mountains.
items.audioZh: 我爺爺奶奶住在山裡一個偏遠的村莊。
items.questionZh: 說話的人的爺爺奶奶住在哪裡？

items.sentenceEn: These pants are too loose for me.
She is taking an advanced English class.

items.stemEn: We need a ____ table with four corners.
items.stemZh: 我們需要一張有四個角的方桌。

items.stemEn: The ____ weight of the rice is five kilos, without the bag.
items.stemZh: 不算袋子，米的淨重是五公斤。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my friends and I hiked to a remote village. On the way, we got lost because our map was old. A kind farmer showed us the way to the village square. There, an old man told us about an unknown lake near the village. Our group was split: some wanted to go, but others were too tired. In the end, we all went, and the lake was beautiful.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我和朋友們去健行，要到一個偏遠的村莊。途中因為地圖太舊，我們迷路了。一位好心的農夫帶我們到村裡的廣場。在那裡，一位老先生告訴我們村子附近有一座不為人知的湖。我們這群人意見分歧：有人想去，有人太累了。最後大家還是一起去了，那座湖很美。

options: 附近有一座不為人知的湖

referenceEn: We are lost in the mountains.
We got lost in the mountains.
rubricZh: 「迷路」可寫例如 be lost、get lost
時態可寫例如 are lost、got lost

referenceEn: The writer of this song is unknown.
The person who wrote this song is unknown.
rubricZh: 用 unknown 表示「未知的」（例如 is unknown）
「寫這首歌的人」可寫，例如 the writer of this song、the person who wrote this song 等
